profile.headline: Security Analyst
profile.summary: Results-driven Cybersecurity Professional with hands-on experience in SIEM cloud security, software development, and system integration. Proven ability to implement and manage secure systems, analyze threats, and collaborate cross-functionally to improve cybersecurity posture. Background in both security operations and software engineering, offering a unique blend of analytical and technical expertise. Seeking to leverage this hybrid skill set in a cybersecurity role focused on cloud security, threat detection, and incident response.
